answer: Each identity must grow a coral reef: the beacon emits an opal pulse each epoch, and the agent must deposit a unique hollow signature. The first layer costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent layer doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at layer 12 (20.4 M iterations). A hollow reef of clones trying to share signatures collapses because each layer binds to the unique identity key—no shared work across clones.
